description.narrative: Detta är ett bidrag till att bevara den biologiska mångfalden genom en ökad kapacitet för att restaurera 100 miljoner hektar av Afrikas skogslandskap.
This is a contribution to biodiversity conservation by strengthening the capacity to restore 100 million hectares of forest landscape in Africa.

Under the second phase of support the AUDA-NEPAD/AFR100 Secretariat aims to actualize the transition from commitments towards implementation by supporting the AFR100 countries in actualizing their restoration commitments on the ground, through various forest and landscape restoration actions. The actualization of the countries restoration commitments will contribute to reversing the negative impacts of deforestation, environmental and land degradation, realize healthy, productive landscapes, enhance livelihoods of smallholder and rural producers, and subsequently build the resilience of rural communities in Africa, who are most susceptible to risk factors.
The Concept Note of AUDA-NEPAD/ AFR100 Secretariat for consideration under the New Swedish Strategy for Regional Cooperation in Africa has three components for the Phase 2 Project, which include:
1) Scaling up the Land Accelerator Programme (LAP): Increased support to Women and Youth restoration entrepreneurs
2) Strengthening Resilience through Sustainable Land Restoration: Support to Implementation of Land Restoration Commitments Support to AFR100
3) Implementation Monitoring: Tracking and reporting AFR100 Implementation
The proposed four-month inception phase will allow the AFR100 Secretariat to further elaborate on the Concept note, expanding on the envisaged activities and implementation modalities for each of the three project components, particularly Component 2, as well as the associated budget for Phase 2.
In addition, during the inception phase, AFR100 secretariat will contibute toAFR100 Management Team (MT) Retreat and Land Accelerator Boot Camp; and will support National Capacity Building Workshop for Strengthening AFR100 Implementation and Upscaling Forest Landscape Restoration in South Africa.

The project design phase included various engagements with other African Union programmes such as the Common African Agro-Parks Programme (CAAPs), African Continental Free Trade Agreement (AfCFTA) and the Great Green Wall for joint programming in the second phase of Sida support.
The AFR100 Management Team Retreat facilitated the much-needed physical planning for accelerating AFR100 Implementation 2023 2025.
The National Capacity Building Workshop held in Eastern Cape, South Africa, contributed towards the AFR100 Secretariats objective of supporting countries to strengthening AFR100 implementation towards achieving the target of restoring 100 million hectares of degraded land and forests in Africa by 2030.
Summary of results:
- Project planning and design workshop: The workshop contributed to the revision of the draft Concept note; and a draft project document and budget for Phase 2 was compiled increasing the number of components from three to five. The AFR100 Secretariat and the World Resources Institute (WRI) finalized a joint project funding proposal (2023 2025) for submission to the Embassy of Sweden Regional Development Cooperation Section in Addis Ababa.
- AFR100 Management Team retreat and land accelerator bootcamp were held in Kigali from 18-22 October 2022. The Land Accelerator bootcamp programme was successfully conducted including capacity building for the Top 15 Land Accelerator restoration entrepreneurs to participate in the Impact Day pitches to investors to mobilize more investments into their businesses.
- National Capacity Building Workshop: Strengthening AFR100 Implementation and up scaling Forest Landscape Restoration (FLR) in South Africa. AUDA-NEPAD conducted field assessment, knowledge exchange and sharing of best practices for implementation of FLR in South Africa, and Community led project proposals for submission to AFR100 Secretariat and AFR100 partners for resource mobilization.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
